title: Qiimaha telefoonada oo kor u kacaya
excerpt: Shirkadaha technology ga  ayaa ka digaya in qiimaha smartphones ku kor u kici doono sabab la xiriirta yaraanta AI chips.
body:
Shirkado badan sida Microsoft, Samsung iyo Dell ayaa bilaabay inay kordhiyaan qiimaha qalabkooda kadib markii AI data centers ay si badan u isticmaaleen chips-ka xasuusta. Tani waxay:

yaraysay supply-ga chips,
kordhisay qiimaha iPhones iyo laptops,
saameysay consoles-ka ciyaaraha sida PlayStation iyo Switch.

Khubaro badan waxay sheegayaan in AI boom-ka uu hadda si toos ah u saameynayo dadka isticmaala technology-ga caadiga ah.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: Telegram Oo Soo Bandhigaysa "AI Bots" Maamulaya Farriimahaaga
excerpt: Telegram oo AI u isticmaalaysa in lagu maareeyo oo lagu kaabo wada sheekaysiga
body: Shirkadda Telegram ayaa qaadday tallaabo weyn iyadoo soo bandhigtay aalado caawiyayaal ah (Assistant Bots) oo ku shaqeeya sirdoonka macmalka ah. Bots-kan waxay awood u leeyihiin inay akhriyaan, kala shaandheeyaan, dabeetana si toos ah u ka u jawaabaan fariimaha qaarkood iyadoo la raacayo oggolaanshaha uu qofku siiyo. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in AI-da hadda lagu dhex milayo fariimaha maalinlaha ah si ay dadka uga caawiso mashquulka.

title: Google I/O 2026: Soo Bandhigista Gemini Omni Iyo Isbedelka Raadinta (Search)
excerpt: Google oo daahfurtay sirdoon cusub iyo qaab cusub oo wax looga raadiyo internetka.
body: Shirka weyn ee Google I/O 2026, Google waxay ku soo bandhigtay moodal cusub oo la yiraahdo Gemini Omni. Moodalkan wuxuu awood u leeyahay inuu si toos ah u fahmo, una beddelo muuqaallada (video) iyo codadka si aad u degdeg badan. Sidoo kale, Google waxay gabi ahaanba beddelaysaa qaabka wax loo raadiyo (Google Search), kaasoo hadda isku beddelaya aalad wada sheekaysi oo kooraysa macluumaadka halkii uu markii hore soo saari lahaa kaliya website-yo linkiyo ah. Google waxay kaloo dib u soo noolaysay muraayada indhaha ee casriga ah (AI Glasses) oo ku shaqaynaya Android XR.

title: Tartanka Chips-ka iyo Moodooyinka jaban (AI Economy)
excerpt: Wargeysyada tignoolajiyada ee bishan ayaa sheegaya
body: Wargeysyada tignoolajiyada ee bishan ayaa sheegaya in suuqii AI uu hadda u guuray dhanka dhaqaalaha iyo kharash dhimista. Shirkadaha Shiinaha (sida Huawei iyo DeepSeek) ayaa suuqa soo geliyay moodooyin AI ah oo aad u jaban iyo microchips gudaha lagu farsameeyay. Tani waxay culays ku haysaa shirkadaha Mareykanka ee horay u hoggaaminayay suuqa, maadaama shirkaduhu hadda rabaan AI shaqada u fududeeya oo kharash yar.
author: MaqaalTech admin

title: Amniga IT-ga: AI vs AI (Cybersecurity)
excerpt: Aduunka Cyber Security-ga wuxuu hadda galay weji cusub oo ah "AI ayaa lala dagaalamayaa AI kale."
body:
Weerarka: Kooxaha jabsada kombuyuutarada (Hackers) waxay hadda isticmaalayaan AI si ay u abuuraan algorithms aad u casriyeysan oo si otomaatig ah u raadinaya ciladaha (vulnerabilities) ku jira software-ka ama mareegaha (websites), iyagoo soo saaraya habab cusub oo lagu jabsado.

Difaaca: Dhanka kale, shirkadaha amniga IT-ga waxay dhisayaan AI si joogto ah u ilaalinaysa shabakadaha (networks) oo baranaysa hab-dhaqanka caadiga ah ee nidaamka, si ay u ogaato oo ay u joojiso weerarka ilbiriqsiyo gudahood ka hor inta uusan khasaare dhicin.
author: MaqaalTech admin

title: Sharciyada AI Act ee Midowga Yurub
excerpt: Aduunka IT-ga iyo Sirdoonka Macmalka ah (AI) hadda aad ayuu u kulul yahay,
body: Midowga Yurub ayaa soo saaray habraacyo cusub oo adag oo ku saabsan hufnaanta AI-da. Waxaa la soo saaray xeerar ku khasbaya shirkadaha inay si cad u calaamadiyaan (watermark) sawirada, codadka, ama qoraalada ay AI-du samaysay si dadka looga ilaaliyo been-abuurka (Deepfakes). Sidoo kale, waxaa gebi ahaanba la mamnuucay AI-yada loo isticmaalo samaynta sawirada qaawan ee dadka nolosha jira iyadoon oggolaansho laga haysan.

title: Telefoonnada Casriga ah ee Shaashadaha Isku-laabma (Foldable Phones) oo Qiimahoodu Hoos u Dhacayo
excerpt: Shirkadaha soo saara telefoonnada sida Samsung, Xiaomi, iyo Motorola ayaa qorsheynaya inay suuqa keenaan telefoonnada la laabo oo qiimo jaban, si ay u soo jiitaan macaamiil badan.
body: Telefoonnada shaashadda weyn ee laalaabma waxay muddo dheer ahaayeen kuwa aad u qaali ah oo ay iibsan karaan kaliya dadka dhaqaalaha dambeeya leh (inta badan ka sarreeya $1,500). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tignoolajiyada samaynta shaashadahan (OLED displays) oo hadda noqotay mid fudud iyo tartanka suuqa oo kordhay awgeed, shirkadaha ayaa bilaabay inay soo saaraan moodallo ka hooseeya $600. Tani waxay la dhigan tahay in sannadkan dhexdiisa ay telefoonnada laalaabma noqon doonaan kuwa qof kastaa iibsan karo.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas 2.0 with Full-Body AI Control
excerpt: The humanoid robot now uses end-to-end neural networks for locomotion and manipulation, eliminating hand-crafted control systems.
body: Boston Dynamics has demonstrated Atlas 2.0, featuring a complete overhaul of its control architecture. The robot now uses a single neural network trained via reinforcement learning to control all joints simultaneously.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: What Companies Need to Know
excerpt: The world's first comprehensive AI regulation framework enters its enforcement phase, with fines up to 6% of global revenue.
body: The European Union's AI Act has entered its first major enforcement phase. Companies deploying AI systems classified as high-risk must now comply with strict transparency, documentation, and testing requirements.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs Ship to Data Centers Globally
excerpt: The next-generation AI accelerator delivers 4x the performance of H100 with improved energy efficiency for large-scale model training.
body: NVIDIA has begun mass shipments of its Blackwell B200 GPUs to hyperscale data centers. Early benchmarks show 4x improvement in AI training throughput compared to the H100, while energy consumption per FLOP improves by 40%.
author: MaqaalTech Staff
